verdict.rationale: Porkbun is a domain registrar and DNS/hosting API, not an agent or MCP host, so consuming external MCP servers is not a capability this kind of product would offer. Its official MCP server, used by Claude, Cursor and other clients, is the server role and belongs to a different story. Nothing in the pack shows Porkbun acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
